scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts GooseAI out/goose-ai-raw.mp4 --crf=18 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --x264-preset=slow --concurrency=6 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/goose-ai-raw.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart out/goose-ai.mp4
scripts.build: npm run halftone && npm run audio && npm run render
scripts.pixel:render: remotion render src/index.ts GooseAIPixel out/goose-ai-pixel-raw.mp4 --crf=18 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --x264-preset=slow --concurrency=6 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/goose-ai-pixel-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/goose-ai-pixel.mp4
scripts.ghibli:render: remotion render src/index.ts GooseAIGhibli out/goose-ai-ghibli-raw.mp4 --crf=18 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --x264-preset=slow --concurrency=6 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/goose-ai-ghibli-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/goose-ai-ghibli.mp4
